mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are at 42 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Area High School under a new moon.

The City of Verona is continuing the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes improvements to the water main, sanitary sewer, and the installation of new concrete sidewalks and driveway aprons.

There is plenty to do in our community today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, followed by ART House 360 events on Thursday.
On October 25, local officers handled a situation at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where a 40-year-old man was arrested for a first offence O W I.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
